Walter White, Flight.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/walter-white/flight

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Walter White, the author, died 1955 (Wikidata Q3565918, P570 = 1955-03-21).

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'Flight was published in 1926 by Walter White.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The text was first published in 1926, before 1931, so it entered the United States public domain 95 years after publication, in 2021.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, Walter White in 1955, makes the text public domain there from 1 January 2026. Nothing in the facts points to France, Spain, Mexico, Colombia or Russia/USSR, so the result is the same whichever of these countries it was first published in.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
